t: Vabuaty Vatu (VUV): What It is and Example
s: December 21, 2020 - The VUV is the abbreviation of the Vanuatu vatu, which is the currency that replaced the former currency of the New Hebrides franc in 1981. Unlike most other currencies, the vatu is not issued in subdivisions, such as cents.

t: Vanuatu vatu - Wikipedia
s: October 14, 2025 - The vatu (abbreviation: VT; ISO code: VUV) is the currency of Vanuatu. It has no subdivisions. The term vatu, used in all three official languages of Vanuatu (English, French, and Bislama), was borrowed from the word for "stone" in some indigenous languages (such as Raga vatu).
